create_LRScheduler: create a learning rate scheduler from a torch optimizer and config dict
step_LRScheduler: step the LRScheduler forward optionally passing validation metrics for ReduceLROnPlateau
get_lr_LRScheduler: get the current learning rate from the LRScheduler optimizer param groups
create_CosineLRLambda: create a CosineLRLambda callable that returns cosine annealing LR multipliers with warmup
call_warmup_lr_lambda: call warmup_lr_lambda to compute a linear warmup then milestone-based LR multiplier
